name: The Grand Venetian
tagline: Romance and luxury on the Strip
description: Inspired by the canals of Venice, The Grand Venetian offers gondola rides, opulent suites with marble bathrooms, and world-class dining. A quintessential Vegas luxury experience combining old-world elegance with modern indulgence.
highlights: Rooftop infinity pool with Strip views
Award-winning Italian restaurant
Exclusive couples spa treatments

name: Caesars Boulevard Hotel
description: Step into ancient Rome in the heart of Las Vegas. With sweeping Roman architecture, celebrity chef restaurants, and an iconic pool complex, Caesars Boulevard sets the gold standard for Vegas opulence.
highlights: Famous garden pool complex
Celebrity chef restaurants
Luxurious full-service spa

name: Desert Bloom Resort & Spa
tagline: Tranquility in the heart of the desert
description: A serene escape offering stunning desert landscape views, award-winning spa treatments, and a host of family-friendly amenities. The perfect base for families seeking both relaxation and adventure in Nevada.
highlights: Lazy river and splash pad for kids
Kids adventure zone with supervised activities
Scenic desert hiking trails nearby

name: The Neon Executive
tagline: Where business meets the bright lights
description: Purpose-built for the modern business traveller, The Neon Executive offers state-of-the-art meeting facilities, high-speed connectivity throughout, and streamlined services that keep you productive from check-in to checkout.
highlights: 24/7 business center with printing and AV
Direct covered walkway to convention center
Same-day laundry and dry cleaning

name: Sunrise Family Suites
description: Designed with families in mind, Sunrise Family Suites features spacious multi-room suites, a themed water park, supervised kids clubs, and diverse dining options that cater to every age and appetite.
highlights: Giant themed water park included in room rate
Kids eat free at all on-site restaurants
Daily family entertainment and magic shows

name: The Mirage View Hotel
description: Perched above the iconic Strip, The Mirage View Hotel offers panoramic views from every room. A vibrant pool scene, excellent cocktail bars, and a buzzing casino floor make this the beating heart of the Vegas experience.
highlights: Panoramic Strip views from every room
Rooftop pool and cocktail bar
Direct access to top nightlife venues

name: Vegas Conference Center Hotel
tagline: The smart choice for corporate travel
description: Adjacent to the Las Vegas Convention Center, this no-fuss hotel is the preferred choice for conference delegates and corporate events. Competitive rates, ample meeting space, and efficient service get you where you need to be.
highlights: 10,000 sq ft of flexible event space
Corporate and group rates available
Airport shuttle service included

name: Encore at Paradise
description: For those who accept nothing but the very best, Encore at Paradise delivers personalised butler service, lavish suites with private terraces, an exclusive pool enclave, and bespoke dining experiences tailored to your wishes.
highlights: Private pool cabanas with dedicated attendants
24-hour personal butler service
Michelin-starred on-site restaurant

name: Golden Sands Family Resort
tagline: Making memories that last a lifetime
description: A beloved Las Vegas institution for family holidays, Golden Sands offers extensive recreational facilities, multiple heated pools, spectacular nightly entertainment, and a warmth that keeps guests coming back year after year.
highlights: Free nightly live entertainment for all ages
Five restaurants and three bars on-site
Massive indoor games and activities zone

name: The Boardwalk Boutique Hotel
description: A refreshingly intimate alternative to the mega-resorts. The Boardwalk Boutique Hotel blends personalised service, thoughtfully curated design, and a prime Strip location — all at an accessible price point that never compromises on quality.
highlights: Boutique-designed rooms with curated artwork
Rooftop cocktail bar with Strip views
Personalised concierge for every guest
